chapter: Reel two to four: pay, tailgate and style
title: The Tin Roof and its sprinkler rain trick
summary: He explains the Tin Roof on Baronne Street owned by Tony DeNapoli, where sprinklers on the roof made fake rain to keep the crowd.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
